repos.description: Free domain registration and practical DNS learning resources for everyone.
repos.summary_zh: DigitalPlat FreeDomain 是一个面向全球用户的免费域名注册平台，提供 .DPDNS.ORG、.US.KG 等专属后缀域名，支持与 Cloudflare 等主流 DNS 服务商集成。项目由 DigitalPlat 基金会独立开发，已服务超 50 万用户，致力于降低建站门槛，构建开放互联网生态。
repos.summary_en: DigitalPlat FreeDomain offers free, unique domain names with extensions like .DPDNS.ORG and .QZZ.IO, enabling individuals and organizations to establish a digital identity without cost. Built by the DigitalPlat Foundation, it integrates seamlessly with popular DNS providers such as Cloudflare and serves over 500,000 users worldwide, promoting an open and accessible web.

repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

repos.description: 韩先凯的人生进阶指南 AI时代 中英双语终身学习指南：AI、学习 、创业、财富、爱情与人生
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
repos.summary_zh: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

repos.description: An advanced guide which might benefit you a lot 🎉 . 人生进阶指南 离谱的人生 离谱的英语学习指南/英语学习教程/英语学习/学英语
repos.summary_zh: 《离谱的英语学习指南》是一份系统化的英语进阶学习指南，结合作者自身高分经验与科学方法，涵盖词汇、听力、阅读、口语、写作及AI辅助等模块，强调语言学习的自然性与趣味性，提供从CEFR等级到实用技巧的完整路径，助力学习者高效突破瓶颈。
repos.summary_en: This advanced English learning guide offers a comprehensive, scientifically-informed approach to mastering English through structured modules on vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing, and AI tools. It emphasizes natural language acquisition and personal enjoyment, providing a clear roadmap from CEFR levels to practical strategies for learners aiming to break through plateaus.

repos.description: TensorFlow Tutorial and Examples for Beginners (support TF v1 & v2)
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 TensorFlow 初学者提供全面且结构化的学习路径，涵盖从基础操作到高级模型的完整示例。通过 Jupyter Notebook 和源码结合的方式，清晰展示 TF v1 与 v2 的实现差异，重点突出现代 API 最佳实践（如 layers、estimator、dataset），适合希望快速上手 TensorFlow 并掌握其核心功能的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive, beginner-friendly tutorial for TensorFlow, featuring clear examples in both notebooks and source code for TF v1 and v2. It covers fundamental operations to advanced models, emphasizing modern API practices such as layers, estimator, and dataset. Ideal for developers seeking hands-on experience with TensorFlow's core functionalities.

repos.description: 面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，吴恩达大模型系列课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是面向开发者的 LLM 入门教程，基于吴恩达大模型系列课程打造，覆盖 Prompt Engineering、RAG、模型微调等全流程。内容涵盖从基础 API 调用到 LangChain 应用开发，提供中文复现代码与 Prompt 优化方案，支持 Jupyter Notebook 实践，助力开发者快速掌握 LLM 应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a developer-focused LLM入门教程 based on Andrew Ng's large language model courses, covering Prompt Engineering, RAG, and fine-tuning. It includes translated, reproduced code examples and optimized Chinese prompts, enabling hands-on learning via Jupyter Notebooks to help developers master LLM application development.

repos.description: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》（李宏毅老师推荐👍，苹果书🍎），PDF下载地址：https://github.com/datawhalechina/leedl-tutorial/releases
repos.summary_zh: 《李宏毅深度学习教程》是台湾大学李宏毅教授经典课程的中文教程，涵盖深度学习核心理论与前沿技术。教程以幽默易懂的方式讲解复杂概念，结合动画案例与详细公式推导，降低学习门槛。内容源自2021年春课程并扩展2017年春课程及外部知识，适合深度学习初学者系统入门。
repos.summary_en: LeeDL-Tutorial is a comprehensive Chinese guide to deep learning based on Professor Hung-yi Lee's renowned courses. It simplifies complex concepts through engaging examples and detailed derivations, covering core theories and techniques. Expanded from the 2021 Spring course with additional content from 2017 and external resources, it serves as an ideal entry point for beginners in deep learning.

repos.description: Android官方培训课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是 Google Android 官方培训课程《Android Training》的中文协作翻译版本，涵盖 Android 应用开发核心知识体系，由社区开发者共同维护。提供在线阅读与在线编辑功能，支持纠错与内容完善，是学习 Android 开发的优质中文资源。
repos.summary_en: This project is the Chinese translation of Google's official Android Training course, collaboratively translated by the community. It covers core Android development topics, offering online reading and editing support for corrections and improvements, serving as a valuable Chinese resource for Android developers.

repos.description: LangChain 的中文入门教程
repos.summary_zh: LangChain 中文入门教程系统讲解大模型应用开发框架，涵盖文档加载、文本分割、向量存储、Chain 链与 Agent 代理等核心概念，提供 OpenAI API 集成、PDF/YouTube 数据处理等实战案例，配套 GitBook 与 Colab 代码，适合 AI 开发者快速上手构建智能应用。
repos.summary_en: This comprehensive LangChain Chinese tutorial covers core concepts like document loading, text splitting, vectorstores, chains, and agents for building LLM-powered applications. It includes practical examples with OpenAI integration, PDF/YouTube data processing, and provides GitBook and Colab code resources for developers to quickly build AI applications.

repos.description: 30 days of React Native demos
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

repos.description: Learn python3 in one picture.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目通过一张图片全面展示 Python3 核心语法与特性，涵盖数据类型、流程控制、函数、类、模块等关键内容，辅以 IPython Notebook 交互版本，适合快速入门与参考。
repos.summary_en: This project presents a comprehensive one-page visual guide to Python 3 syntax and features, including data types, control flow, functions, classes, and modules, with an interactive IPython Notebook version for easy learning and reference.

repos.description: Codelabs management & hosting tools
repos.summary_zh: Google Codelabs 工具集提供强大的交互式教程创作与托管能力，支持通过 Google Docs 或 Markdown 进行灵活的内容编写，自动生成响应式网页教程。核心工具 claat 可将文档转换为 HTML、Markdown 等格式，支持实时预览、用户进度追踪及多平台适配，适用于教育、技术分享和开发者活动场景。
repos.summary_en: The Google Codelabs tools enable powerful creation and hosting of interactive instructional tutorials via Google Docs or Markdown. The core claat tool transforms documents into responsive web-based codelabs, supporting real-time preview, user progress tracking, and multi-format output (HTML/Markdown), ideal for education and developer events.

repos.description: React Native入门指南
repos.summary_zh: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

repos.description: Trying to complete over 100 projects in various categories in golang.
repos.summary_zh: 《Go实战开发》是一本通过100+实战项目系统学习Go语言的书籍，涵盖Web开发、网络编程、数据库操作等全场景。作者astaxie结合PHP开发经验，以项目驱动方式帮助开发者掌握Go核心特性与工程实践，配套开源代码与社区支持，适合中高级开发者进阶。
repos.summary_en: 《Go实战开发》 is a project-driven book teaching Go through 100+ practical projects across categories like web development and networking. Authored by astaxie, it leverages PHP experience to guide developers in mastering Go's core features and engineering practices, with open-source code and community support for advanced learning.

repos.description: Python 黑魔法手册
repos.summary_zh: 《Python 黑魔法手册》是一本深入解析 Python 语言隐藏特性与进阶技巧的电子书，涵盖冷门语法、Shell 高级用法、代码炫技及底层机制解读，旨在帮助开发者突破常规认知，掌握高效、优雅的 Python 编程范式。
repos.summary_en: The 'Magic Python' handbook is an eBook exploring advanced and lesser-known Python features, including obscure syntax, shell tricks, code hacks, and deep technical insights, designed to help developers master elegant and efficient Python programming beyond basic tutorials.

repos.description: 翻译自Miguel Grinberg的blog https://blog.miguelgrinberg.com 的2017年新版The Flask Mega-Tutorial教程
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是 Miguel Grinberg 《The Flask Mega-Tutorial》2017年版的完整中文翻译，涵盖从基础到部署的全栈开发实践。通过23章系统讲解 Flask 框架核心功能，包括模板、表单、数据库、用户认证、Ajax、全文搜索、国际化及多平台部署（Linux/Heroku/Docker），适合中高级开发者构建复杂 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains the complete Chinese translation of Miguel Grinberg's 2017 'The Flask Mega-Tutorial', covering full-stack web development with Flask from basics to deployment. Spanning 23 chapters, it systematically teaches core Flask features including templating, forms, databases, authentication, Ajax, full-text search, internationalization, and multi-platform deployment (Linux/Heroku/Docker), ideal for intermediate to advanced developers building complex web applications.

repos.description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.description: Three.js 系列教程，学习和探索 Three.js 世界。
repos.summary_zh: Three.js 系列教程，系统讲解 WebGL 3D 图形开发技术，涵盖场景构建、坐标系（左手/右手）、球极坐标、BufferGeometry 等核心概念。作者结合官方文档与实战经验，提供学习路径，并分享向 Three.js 官方提交 PR 的贡献经历，强调持续跟进版本更新重要性。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive Three.js tutorial series covering core concepts like 3D scene creation, coordinate systems (left/right-handed), spherical coordinates, and BufferGeometry. The author shares learning insights, official documentation usage tips, and contributions to the Three.js GitHub repo, emphasizing staying updated with version changes.

repos.description: vue2.0-tutorial
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是一个基于 Vue 2.0 的单页应用教程，使用 vue-cli、vue-router、vuex 和 vue-resource 构建完整前端架构，结合 webpack 实现热加载与组件化开发，并集成 Bootstrap UI 框架，适合学习现代 Vue.js 项目工程化实践。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a Vue 2.0 tutorial for building a single-page application using vue-cli, vue-router, vuex, and vue-resource. It demonstrates project scaffolding, component-based development, hot-reload via webpack, and integration with Bootstrap, serving as a practical guide for modern Vue.js engineering practices.

repos.description: RN 开源之初，写几个Mini-App
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是React Native早期实战项目集合，包含通讯录、LBS附近服务、豆瓣API搜索等Mini-App。涵盖文件系统Node.js服务端、通讯录管理、公告系统、地图定位及Webview集成，提供完整移动端开发范例，适合RN初学者学习全栈移动应用开发。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains early React Native practical projects including address book, LBS nearby services, and Douban API search apps. It covers Node.js file-based backend, contact management, announcements, map positioning, and Webview integration, serving as a comprehensive full-stack mobile development tutorial for RN beginners.

repos.description: AngularJS入门教程——AngularJS中文社区提供
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供完整的AngularJS入门教程，涵盖快速开始、模板系统、双向绑定、路由、REST服务等核心功能。由AngularJS中文社区维护，包含15个循序渐进的实践章节，适合前端开发者系统学习AngularJS框架。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive AngularJS tutorial covering core features like templates, two-way binding, routing, and REST services. Maintained by the AngularJS Chinese Community, it includes 15 progressive chapters ideal for developers learning the framework.

repos.description: Create stunning screen recordings for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.
repos.summary_zh: CursorLens 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为创作者、开发者和团队设计。基于 OpenScreen 构建，深度优化 macOS 原生捕获流程，支持全屏/窗口录制、摄像头画中画、语音录制、时间轴剪辑、字幕生成及多比例导出，无水印且商用免费。
repos.summary_en: CursorLens is a free, open-source screen recorder and editor built on OpenScreen, enhanced for native macOS capture and editing. It supports full-screen/app recording, camera overlay, voice input, timeline editing, subtitle generation, and multi-aspect export—all watermark-free and commercially usable.

repos.description: ChatGPT&AIGC资料汇总，包含前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目和商业变现等
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为ChatGPT与AIGC领域的综合性资料库，涵盖前沿资讯、应用案例、技术教程、开源项目与商业变现路径，提供注册升级指南及深度行业研报，助力开发者与从业者快速掌握AI技术生态与落地场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates comprehensive resources on ChatGPT and AIGC, including cutting-edge news, application cases, technical tutorials, open-source projects, and monetization strategies. It provides registration/guide tutorials and in-depth industry reports to help developers and professionals quickly master the AI technology ecosystem and real-world applications.
